content.value_statement: Writers often start with scattered ideas or unclear topics. This skill guides topic selection, outline refinement, and article drafting in a staged workflow.
actual_capabilities: Diagnoses whether a writing idea is clear or still exploratory.
Guides users through idea mining when the topic is unclear.
Helps select a core topic, reader value, and one-sentence thesis.
Builds an article outline with section roles and word ranges.
Drafts and revises a short article from the confirmed outline.
limitations: It is optimized for Chinese-language article planning and drafting.
It relies on user input for facts, examples, and personal voice.
It does not perform independent fact checking or source research.
File creation depends on the host agent and workspace permissions.

use_cases.title: Plan a Thought Essay
use_cases.description: A writer turns scattered notes into a focused article with a clear reader benefit.

use_cases.title: Prepare Course Reflections
use_cases.description: A student shapes class observations into a short reflective article.

use_cases.title: Draft Product Commentary
use_cases.description: A founder organizes product lessons into a concise post for customers or peers.

prompt_templates.title: Start With a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to write about AI tools in learning. Help me decide whether my view is clear.

prompt_templates.title: Mine Scattered Ideas
prompt_templates.prompt: I have many thoughts about remote work, but no topic. Ask me questions and capture useful insights.

prompt_templates.title: Shape the Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: My thesis is that durable tools improve with use. Help me build a 1000-word article outline.

prompt_templates.title: Draft and Revise
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my confirmed outline and voice to write the article. Then ask for targeted feedback before revising.

output_examples.input: I want to write about Skills, but I do not know the angle.
output: The skill first classifies the idea as unclear.
It asks for recent scenes, opinions, and examples.
It records potential insights for topic selection.

output_examples.input: My topic is clear: why repeated practice matters.
output_examples.output: The skill moves directly to outline discussion, confirms the thesis, defines reader value, and proposes section lengths.

output_examples.input: This outline is approved. Please draft.
output_examples.output: The skill writes a conversational article, keeps the user voice, and asks what should change next.

best_practices: Share your target reader and the change you want the reader to make.
Provide concrete scenes, examples, and phrases you want to preserve.
Approve the topic and outline before asking for a full draft.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final article before the core viewpoint is clear.
Do not use the skill as a fact checker for unsupported claims.
Do not let generated filenames reuse sensitive or system file names.

faq.question: What language is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for Chinese writing workflows, but the planning logic can help other languages.

faq.question: Does it write immediately?
faq.answer: No. It first checks topic clarity, then builds an outline before drafting.

faq.question: Can it help when I only have fragments?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses a mining stage to collect ideas, examples, and useful phrases.

faq.question: Does it research facts?
faq.answer: No. You should provide facts or ask another research tool to verify claims.

faq.question: Will it keep my personal voice?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks the assistant to preserve your wording and tone.

faq.question: Can it create files?
faq.answer: It may create Markdown notes, outlines, or drafts when the host tool allows file writing.
